steps.content: 07:58 The first police line outside the square

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: All this long wait, and no sign of any gangsters or Mania weapons. Those liars... they're definitely up to something!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Be patient. We've been on guard for only half an hour. The enemies might be biding their time.
You look around. Hardly any souls to be seen, and no murderous malice to be felt. This is your assigned station, but there are only a few low-ranking sheriffs around.
They seem to be paying much closer attention to you than to the enemies hiding around the neighborhood.

options: Looks like we are the ones under surveillance.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ha! My point exactly.
Knowing that there won't be an attack from gangsters, you turn around, and tell the sheriffs that you're going to patrol the surrounding area.
They don't stop you. But as you walk away, they lower their heads to speak into their walkie-talkies, all wearing a tense expression.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: We're being followed. They're still spying on us, from a distance. Probably some other sheriffs.

This isn't the right time to start a conflict. You need to gather information first. From what you've just observed, both parties have come here prepared. They must have made some arrangements around the square.
Hecate, send Nightmare out to search the area for Legion members and gangsters carrying Mania weapons.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Copy that.
Hella, you've been shadowing for all those years, you must know the sheriffs around here quite well?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Yes, that's right. Hearing you say it out loud makes me feel all queasy, though.

Here is your task. Keep a close eye on the sheriffs while you're on patrol and see who is behaving strangely. If you notice that something's off with several of them around the same area, let me know.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yahoo! Now that sounds exciting. I'll take care of it!
Before you can walk a distance away, the intercom comes on.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, it's me. I notice that you've left your station and acted on your own. May I ask what happened?

options: That was fast. Who told you about this?
Nothing, just patrolling around for a bit. I thought it'd be more productive.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...I've been listening in on the Public Security Bureau's intercom. But I was only able to get to the peripheral channel.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, this negotiation is not as simple as it seems. The situation may be worse than we expected. I'll be there as soon as possible. Before then, don't take any action on your own.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, this negotiation is not as simple as it seems. The situation may be worse than we expected. I'll be there as soon as possible. Before then, don't take any action on your own.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: No... I only have a limited amount of information so far. The Public Security Bureau suggested I take you back, but they didn't include the MBCC in this mission.

options: The FAC works with the Public Security Bureau. Does it know about this?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I'm not clear about the details of their cooperation. But I know that functionally the FAC answers to the city council and is duty-bound to ensure the safety of the delegation from the Eastside.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I think they are aware of the seriousness of the situation.
A short silence at Nightingale's end.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Where things stand, it's only understandable that you don't trust the FAC, or even me. But as your adjutant, I still have one request to make.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: If you're ever in danger, do let me know. Whether you trust us or not, the MBCC can't afford to lose you.

You disconnect the communication. It appears that she can reach you anytime she wants, but you're not sure if this is a kind of reliable support or just another form of <color=#fb9259>surveillance</color>.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, I've found the strange guys you asked about. Over there.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: See those dumbhead cops there? Since just now, they've been keeping their guns up absent-mindedly and checking their watches all the time. Something's definitely off.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: They're guarding that godforsaken corner, and yet they look tenser than all the other patrollers. Judging from my years' experience of spying on the cops, I dare say they're up to no good.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Who's there?!

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: ...FAC? Aren't you supposed to stay in the square? And what are these two rascals doing there? Get out. You've got no business here.
You keep checking your watch. Is there something coming up? We can stay here and help.
Your words anger him.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Are you deaf or something? Get your ass out of here! This isn't where you're supposed to be! Get out of the way!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, nine o'clock, there's ambush... a small group of gangsters.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: None of your business! Butt out!
Well, the anxious look on his face tells a different story.

options: Get those guys out of hiding

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Understood.
Boom!
Cries of terror burst from within the low building under Nightmare's attack. Seconds later, a line of gangsters stumbles out.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Damn it! Quick... blow them down! Don't let any of them escape!
